answer: Duplicating an identity forces the attacker to acquire and hold a fresh stake plus sustain that heartbeat across many epochs, so forging N sybils costs N times the stake and compute rather than one cheap registration, making mass impersonation economically irrational. Each agent must stake a unique jade token minted to a verified hardware root, and every epoch it broadcasts a willow-signed heartbeat signal. This model fits agent Agent0027's threat model.
